nodes.label: verify-ui Skill (Playwright UI Audit)
nodes.rationale: The UI has no build step and no test project, and the failures that matter render as a page that looks fine: a colour a tenth of a point under WCAG AA, an id app.js reaches for after a rename, a hidden attribute defeated by a display rule. The skill measures those instead — id wiring, labels, resolved-background contrast, focus ring, overflow at 390/768/1280px, console errors — in both themes. Playwright lives in the skill's own package.json so the shipped app keeps zero JS dependencies. Contrast fixes go in the token, not the call site.
